items.title: Suno Fires Back Against Apple’s Subpoena Opposition, Doubling Down on Its Push for Information About ‘Current License Negotiations,’ ‘Anti-AI Deal Terms,’ and More
items.summary: Suno is doubling down on its Apple subpoena push, arguing that the information being sought – about Apple Music’s major label licensing talks, “anti-AI deal terms,” and more – is central to its fair use and copyright misuse arguments. The AI music platform took aim at Apple’s motion to quash in a 24-page opposition fil…

items.title: Elvis Presley IP Owners Sue Anthropic Over Allegations of Copyright Infringement
items.summary: Elvis Presley’s rightsholders have sued Anthropic with allegations of copyright infringement over 274 of his songs used to train AI models without permission. AI company Anthropic faces yet another copyright infringement lawsuit, this time filed by the owners of Elvis Presley’s music in a case that accuses the company…

items.title: As UMG v. Suno Subpoenas Target the MLC, Multiple Investors, DistroKid, and Now Apple Music, Are Game-Changing Disclosures on the Horizon?
items.summary: As Suno fends off an ever-growing number of music industry copyright complaints, a raft of subpoena showdowns – including the AI platform’s own document and deposition demands – are now in full swing. Does that mean game-changing disclosures are on the horizon? Time will tell, though the current evidence suggests yes.…

items.title: Anthropic sued over Elvis catalog — and the 274-song copyright battle shows the AI industry's 'fair use' excuses are getting old
Claude’s lyrics are diluting real lyrics, say music publishers in latest Anthropic proceedings
items.summary: The big debate over whether or not AI training is fair use under US copyright law was taking place in court again yesterday, this time in the context of music, specifically lyrics, with the copyright legal battle between AI company Anthropic and the Universal, Concord and ABKCO music publishers

items.title: Reservoir Sues Suno and Anthropic Over AI Music Copyright, Seeking Nearly $338 Million
AI Music Copyright Lawsuit — BTS & Psy Songs Used Without Permission in $12B Legal Battle
Suno Accused of Training AI on BTS and Psy Hits Without Permission in Copyright Case Over 60,202 Recordings
Suno fights to make Apple testify on whether Apple Music could survive without UMG and Sony, claiming the majors use their catalogs ‘as a cudgel’ to win anti-AI concessions
items.summary: Suno also wants an Apple witness to testify about Apple’s current licensing talks with both majors and streaming fraud on Apple Music. Source

items.title: Proteger los derechos de autor de la música frente al desafío de la inteligencia artificial.
UMG talks AI music: ‘The volume is growing faster than the safeguards’
items.summary: Universal Music Group’s quarterly financial earnings-call yesterday saw boss Sir Lucian Grainge sounding the latest alarm around AI music. He cited Deezer’s latest figures showing more than 90,000 fully AI-generated tracks are being uploaded to streaming services every day. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Propietarios de la música de Elvis Presley demandan a Anthropic por infracción de derechos de autor

tip.title: Los covers necesitan licencia aunque des crédito
tip.body: Acreditar al autor no sustituye la licencia. Para publicar un cover en plataformas necesitas la licencia mecánica correspondiente, y para usarlo en video, además, la sincronización.

tip.title: Covers need a license even if you give credit
tip.body: Crediting the songwriter is not a license. Releasing a cover on platforms requires a mechanical license, and using it in a video also requires a sync license.
